title: Account Ban Warning
scenario: A game message says your account will be banned unless you appeal through a provided link.

answers.A: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.B: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.
answers.C: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.D: Report/block it and do not share private details.

explanation: Account Ban Warning: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Appeals should happen inside the official game platform.
